Lua fills solid stone, sets mazelevel/hardfloor/icedpools/noflip, initializes smoothed unjoined lit ice mines, places its 40x13 fragment, then creates regions, stairs, objects, traps and monsters in definition order.

dependencies: Existing createSpecialLevelApi solidfill/mines level_init, level_flags, map, relative selection.area, region, stair, non_diggable, object, trap and monster descriptors provide the required results. No generic descriptor owner edit is identified by this source trace; combined runtime reachability remains to be verified.

lspo_level_flags records icedpools on the canonical frame and clears coder.allow_flips for noflip. splev_initlev passes icedpools to mkmap, whose finish pass tags generated ICE as ICED_POOL and lights the requested mines background. Preserve this source flag lifetime and suppress both postprocessing flip RNG gates.

mapFromRows uses centered odd-parity placement and skips x transparent cells, matching sp_lev.c lspo_map 6279-6293. Preserve the exact 40x13 rows, including trailing spaces, pool P, lava L and stone spaces. The Lua discards the returned written-cell selection; its relative selection.area covers the stated rectangle.

The up stair at relative (48,14) is intentionally outside the 40x13 fragment. C sp_lev.c get_location 1202-1278 offsets fixed coordinates by xstart/ystart then checks whole-level isok; JS room_coordinates get_location mirrors that behavior. Do not clamp it to fragment bounds or replace it with random placement. Down stair remains relative (20,6).

Fifteen no-argument object descriptors use canonical random class/coordinate creation; four named fire traps precede two random trap descriptors. No explicit non-species tin, alignment expression, inventory callback or named artifact exists in this program.

Seventeen positional fire-ant descriptors and positional ant-class a retain their default peaceful/gender parsing. Two hostile class H tables bracket seven hostile fire-giant id tables; preserve distinct argument forms, class selection and table RNG order. Existing makemon_create admits nonunique true giants and source-owned giant weapons/gem inventory; any newly exposed species refusal needs its own source audit before edits.

Lua consumes selection.area results only and discards descriptor returns. Canonical internal coordinate, class, terrain and creation results must remain in their existing owners. No placeholder result or copied rectangular protected-mask helper is needed.

Val-goal and other quest programs have separate ledger ownership. Proposed quest_levels changes are only this loader import/function/registry key; no alignment macro, spinach-tin or shared descriptor contract change is proposed.
